title_zh: 那曲市领导“八一”建军节看望慰问驻地部队官兵
title_en: Nagqu Leaders Visit and Greet Troops on Army Day
summary_zh: 2026年8月1日，那曲市委书记张海波、市长扎西多吉等赴那曲军分区看望慰问基层官兵，共庆建军99周年。
summary_en: On August 1, 2026, Nagqu Municipal Party Secretary Zhang Haibo and Mayor Zhaxi Dorje visited troops at Nagqu Military Sub-command to greet grassroots soldiers on the 99th Army Day.
